title: Pickup Complete

accessorials_needed.label: Accessorials needed so far? (lumper, temp check, straps)

voice_questions: Hi [driver name] with [carrier company], this is Zuum calling about load ###
Have you been loaded and left the dock?
If they have left the dock, ask what time did you pull out?
Does the PO or BOL on your paperwork match the rate confirmation? If not, please stay at the shipper - do not leave until this is corrected and you get Zuum's approval
Are you the local/OTR driver who will be delivering this load, or will another driver take over?
Where are you heading next - please confirm the delivery location
What is your estimated time of arrival to that destination?
Is there anything else you need assistance with regarding this load?

Loaded_and_left_dock.description: Whether the driver has been loaded and left the dock

Departure_time.description: Time the driver pulled out from the shipper, as stated by the driver

PO_BOL_matches_rate_con.description: Whether the PO or BOL on the paperwork matches the rate confirmation

BOL_issue_resolved.description: If BOL doesn't match, whether the driver will stay to resolve the issue

Driver_will_deliver.description: Whether this driver will deliver the load or hand off to another driver

Next_destination_confirmed.description: The confirmed delivery location where driver is headed

ETA_to_destination.description: Driver's estimated time of arrival to the destination

Shipper_issues_reported.description: Whether the driver reported any problems at the shipper

Additional_assistance_needed.description: Whether the driver needs any additional assistance
